content: उपपत्तिः {%f.%} .²1 Happening, occurring, becoming visible, appearance, production, birth; अथोपपत्तिं छलनापरोऽपराम् <ls>Śi. 1. 69</ls> (जन्म); इष्टानिष्टोपपत्तिषु <ls>Bg. 13. 9</ls>. .²2 Cause, reason, ground; प्रियेषु यैः पार्थ विनोपपत्तेः <ls>Ki. 3. 52</ls>. .²3 Reasoning, argument; उपपत्तिमदूर्जितं वचः <ls>Ki. 2. 1</ls>; देवि सोपपत्तिकमभिहितम् . <ls>Nāg. 5</ls> argumentative; giving a reason for the establishment of a matter; <ls>S. D. 482</ls>. .²4 Fitness, propriety. .²5 Termination, end. .²6 Association, connection. .²7 Acceptance, adoption; <ls>Mv. 5</ls>. .²8 Ascertainment, demonstration, demonstrated conclusion; उपपत्तिरुदाहृता बलात् <ls>Ki. 2. 28</ls>. .²9 (In <ab>Arith.</ab> or <ab>Geom.</ab>) Proof, demonstration. .²10 A means, an expedient. .²11 Assistance, support, help; ततः प्रजह्ने सममेव तत्र तैरपेक्षितान्योन्यबलोपपत्तिभिः <ls>Ki. 14. 44</ls>. .²12 Doing, effecting, gaining; accomplishment; स्वार्थोपपत्तिं दुर्बलाशः <ls>R. 5. 12</ls>; तात्पर्यानुपपत्तितः <ls>Bhāṣā P.</ls>; <ls>H. 3. 111</ls>; see अनुपपत्ति. .²13 Attainment, getting; असंशयं प्राक् तनयोपपत्तेः <ls>R. 14. 78</ls>; <ls>Ki. 3. 1</ls>. .²14 Religious abstraction (समाधि). .²15 Accident, chance; उपपत्त्योपलब्धेषु लोकेषु च समो भव <ls>Mb. 12. 288. 11</ls>. .²16 Suitability, expediency; उपपत्तिमदूर्जिताश्रयं नृपमूचे वचनं वृकोदरः <ls>Ki. 2. 1</ls>; <ls>Bhāg. 4. 28. 68</ls>.
